pictures.name: EPN1-Banished
pictures.prompt: A gate of ancient Rome in the 90s AD, soldiers in red cloaks waving a line of bearded philosophers in plain cloaks out through the arch onto the road. Among them, Epictetus, now a thin man in his fifties with grey hair and a grey beard, in a plain brown cloak, leaning on a wooden walking staff, calm, walking out with the others. Grey morning light, the city walls looming behind. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
